new_result.statement: For a rank-two indefinite three-coordinate core B with null unit vector k, two nonzero eigenvalues of modulus at least one, arbitrary product bank Y, arbitrary symmetric H, and null-direction coupling 2(k^T U) r^T Y with ||r||_2>=1, the output density is at most sqrt(3)[4+(7/2)log 2]<11.131, uniformly over arbitrary affine shifts, outside conditioning, fragmented or unbounded cap-one input laws, and without moments.
new_result.special_normalized_bound: For B=diag(1,-1,0), k=e3, ||r||_2=1: ||p_Q||_infinity <=4+(7/2)log2=6.4260151319... for arbitrary symmetric H.
new_result.mechanism: Condition on the product bank only after forming its linear aggregate Z=r^T Y. A sharp bathtub estimate gives P(|2 beta U Z+G(Y)-t|<rho)<=q(1+log(1/q)), q=2M rho/|beta|, and exact layer cake pays the physical-pair logarithmic singularity without normalized thin-fiber caps.

partner_result_applied.application: For singleton diffuse banks r_j=1/sqrt(d), corrected r26 gives C4 sqrt(2d); the new aggregate-before-log theorem gives 4+(7/2)log2 uniformly in d and arbitrary H. The partner projection cap ||p_(r^T Y)||_infinity<=sqrt(2)/||r||_2 is also used at the exact Schur remainder.

other_source.scope: invertible indefinite physical pair; arbitrary affine perturbations; logarithmic density envelope

remaining_implication: From bare s_3(A)>=1, obtain an exhaustive product-preserving structural alternative exposing the rank-two-null aggregate core or an already-paid ridge/cross-volume/mixed-hub exit before reciprocal selection of tiny physical coefficients.
